Name: (CP)Food Fantasy - Woodland Harmony Furniture
Author: Yvbie
Description:
————8.30————
加入了包括壁纸和地板在内的23款来自游戏食物语中木韵流芳阁的家具。加入的两款壁纸，一款是木韵流芳的壁纸，另外一款是云华引春的壁纸。地板是木韵流芳的地板。另外，木韵流芳还有一个家具忘记制作了，会在下次更新补上。
Added 23 furniture items from the Food Fantasy "Woodland Harmony" series, including wallpapers and flooring. Among the newly added wallpapers, one is from the "Woodland Harmony" set, and the other is from the "Ethereal Spring" collection. The flooring also belongs to the "Woodland Harmony" set. Additionally, one furniture item from the "Woodland Harmony" series was accidentally omitted and will be included in the next update.
————9.19————
将上次未加入的一款家具补上了。
The previously missing piece of furniture has now been added.

Manifest.Name: Woodland Harmony
Manifest.Description: A set of decorative furniture from Woodland Harmony(a furniture collection in the game Food Fantasy) that can be placed both indoors and outdoors
Manifest.Author: YVbie
